record.hypothesis: Apply causal recency pooling to GRU states with weights 0.8^(t-j), normalized over observed nonpadding positions j≤t. Use pooled states at every supervised training position and select the final real pooled position at inference. Earlier evidence supports testing this readout on the current unit-normalized embedding incumbent, where the interaction remains untested. Preserve truncation, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer across all four datasets; keep predictor behavior consistent.
